notes: Original catalog facts, source archive identity and target/export capabilities remain unchanged. The package source and binary profiles retain all original upstream files.

Upstream --test can return zero for an empty or nonexistent test directory. The installed check requires exactly ten pinned fixtures, nonempty original expected outputs, actual execution of ten tests and matching output bytes.
Official fixture checks execute on writable scratch copies: the original test oracles and installed source tree are never rewritten.

The functional workflow also checks --start/--stop timestamp selection, recursive --all, capture-file analysis and errors using explicitly synthetic trace durations. These tests are not measurements of a compiler or physical system.

Clang is not needed to analyze existing traces. Producing new traces requires a compatible separately installed Clang with -ftime-trace. This profile does not run a new Clang compilation, linking/LTO analysis or a full OCI build.

CMake/Ninja are build-only and can use exact private Debian bindings during maintainer replay. Existing system build tools and runtime libraries are recorded without claiming a complete pinned APT installation.

Worker028 adds real Clang 17 -ftime-trace compilation of two translation units, temporal capture and nonempty analysis. Set CPG_CLANGXX to the matching compiler when it is not on PATH. The included IWYU companion clang++-17 is one validated producer.
The original exact CPG APT prerequisites remain mandatory. A successful independent private native build does not override a formally blocked package-manager installation.
